entries.bfbe0381b564a4cf: Under its corporate purpose “Activate Your Life” and management vision “an innovation company most trusted by customers around the world,” it formulated the medium-term management plan “INNOVATION30” for 2026 to 2030. Its basic strategies are three: business expansion and growth investment (expansion of the Cosmetics Business and focus on the EHD field in the Chemicals Business), strengthening of financial and capital strategy, and sustainability management; and it sets a revenue target of ¥70 billion for 2030.
